edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making the privileged owner caller-controlled at deployment.
Owned constructor reads msg.sender to establish ownership.
transferOwnership reads the owner state variable inside the onlyOwner modifier check.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before executing transferOwnership.
_newOwner parameter value is written into the newOwner state variable.
transferOwnership stores the pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before executing.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner to validate the caller.
acceptOwnership transfers ownership by setting owner = newOwner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0) after transfer.

totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the supply.
balanceOf uses the tokenOwner parameter as the balances mapping key.

transfer writes updated values into the balances mapping.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transfer performs balance debit/credit arithmetic on the balances mapping.
approve uses the spender parameter as the allowance key.
approve writes the tokens parameter as the allowance amount.
approve keys the allowance on msg.sender.
approve writes into the allowed nested mapping.
transferFrom uses the from parameter as the debited balance key.
transferFrom uses the to parameter as the credited balance key.
transferFrom uses the tokens parameter as amount for balance and allowance arithmetic.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller address.
transferFrom writes updated balances for from and to.
transferFrom writes the reduced allowance into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom calls safeSub for both the balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom calls safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
transferFrom performs balance and allowance subtraction arithmetic that can overflow/underflow if checks fail.
allowance uses tokenOwner parameter as first mapping key.
allowance uses spender parameter as second mapping key.
allowance reads from the allowed nested mapping.
allowance returns the remaining local variable.
approveAndCall uses spender parameter for the allowance key and external call target.
approveAndCall uses tokens parameter for allowance and callback payload.
approveAndCall forwards the data parameter into the external callback.
approveAndCall keys the allowance on msg.sender and forwards msg.sender to the callback.
approveAndCall writes the granted allowance into the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall executes an external callback into the spender contract via receiveApproval.
The malicious spender callback can re-enter transferFrom and consume or manipulate allowances and balances.
The external receiveApproval callback can re-enter approveAndCall, re-triggering external calls.

tokens parameter is passed to the external ERC20 transfer call.
transferAnyERC20Token reads the owner address as the external transfer destination.
transferAnyERC20Token shares the onlyOwner access-control modifier pattern.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before the external token transfer executes.

safeSub reads the b parameter as the subtrahend.

safeDiv reads the a parameter as the dividend.
safeDiv reads the b parameter as the divisor.
safeDiv produces the c local variable as a / b.
